name: Mei
source: Mei is the daughter of the vampires that rule over Asia. Due to her wealthy upbringing, she is very spoiled and always needs to get her own way. With the help of her mother Ling Guo, she knows how to seduce others to get what she wants and has high ambitions. She is also very proud of how flexible her "beautiful body" is.
